abilities.name: Ember Bolt
abilities.description: A searing bolt along a line. Slightly under a pure Firepower's auto — the buffs make up the difference.

abilities.name: Flare Burst
abilities.description: A bursting flare: 18 damage and Reveal for a turn. The roster's stealth counter — checks ambushers and brush campers.

abilities.name: Stoke the Flame
abilities.description: Allies in the aimed area gain Might and Energized for a turn. Cinder makes damage, not HP. Self-cast when fighting alone.

abilities.name: Backdraft
abilities.description: Vanish in a gout of smoke, reappearing up to 3 squares away. Dodges Blast attacks aimed at your old square.

ultimate.name: Solar Flare
ultimate.description: A miniature sun detonates at the aimed area: 35 damage and Weaken for a turn. Damage now, and a blunted counter-swing after. (100 energy)
